the quantitative 3-D evaluation of a degradable biomaterial, the polymer sponge, using synchroton radiation.
the development of a non-destructive 3-D evaluation method to characterize porous biomaterials.
the quantitative 3-D characterization of a degradable porous material for tissue augmentation.

the 2-D approach is a fast method for the characterization of porous biomaterials with a high reproducibility, but it is not able to reveal the full 3-D microstructure.
